subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 11 to 16. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '14'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/081e295337a5f49db09f56a49a773652375e35e8aa73b527f8d7f0d7e0604754.png]
solution:
**Explanation :**

Let's take common number in both the dices

12 and 13 both are common in both the dices. Now move clockwise direction in both dice.

13-12-14 first dice

13-11-12 second dice

13 is opposite to 12 and 12 is opposite to 13

so, 14 is opposite to 11 as shown below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6029171c747c513992e3ee49f30565843e1c1c3498fc9868cb42d50797b574aa.png] 

Hence, **11 **is the **correct answer.**
